places-galeria-alta-de-la-masia-la-covas.story: From Morella it runs 162 km to Morella; allow about 2 h 48 of riding. It goes by way of Abric del mas dels Ous, Cova dels Cavalls, La Covassa and back through Cova dels Cavalls. The highest point is about 1,200 m. The line favours views over speed.
